What it’s for

A gear-line reagent. Each quality reroll of knick armor uses one.

Dropped by Ogre: Ogre Youth, Gaunt Ogre, Ogre, Ogre Mauler, Ogre Butcher, Ogre Charger, Ogre Shaman, Ogre Elder, Mountain Ogre, Ogre Warchief, about 1 kill in 500 (an elite 1 in 50).

See Reforging & reagents for the odds and fees, and Reagents for every reagent.
